1.w: And all Israel was reckoned, and behold, they are written in the Book of the Kings of Israel. And Judah was removed to Babylon for their trespass.

2.w: And the first dwellers who [were] in their possessions in their cities of Israel [were] the priests, the Levites, and the Nethinim.

3.w: And in Jerusalem dwelt some of the sons of Judah, and some of the sons of Benjamin, and some of the sons of Ephraim and Manasseh:

4.w: Uthai son of Ammihud, son of Omri, son of Imri, son of Bani of Perez son of Judah.

5.w: And of the Shilonite: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

6.w: And of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred and ninety.

7.w: And of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu son of Meshullam, son of Hodaviah, son of Senuah;

8.w: and Ibneiah son of Jeroham; and Elah son of Uzzi, son of Michri; and Meshullam son of Shephatiah, son of Reuel, son of Ibnijah;

9.w: and their brothers according to their generations—nine hundred and fifty-six. All these men [were] heads of fathers according to the house of their fathers.

10.w: And of the priests: Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin;

11.w: and Azariah son of Hilkiah, son of Meshullam, son of Zadok, son of Meraioth, son of Ahitub, leader in the house of God;

12.w: and Adaiah son of Jeroham, son of Pashhur, son of Malchijah; and Maasai son of Adiel, son of Jahzerah, son of Meshullam, son of Meshillemoth, son of Immer;

13.w: and their brothers, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and sixty mighty of valor for the work of the service of the house of God.

14.w: And of the Levites: Shemaiah son of Hasshub, son of Azrikam, son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

15.w: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah son of Micha, son of Zichri, son of Asaph;

16.w: and Obadiah son of Shemaiah, son of Galal, son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah son of Asa, son of Elkanah, who dwelt in the villages of the Netophathite.

17.w: And the gatekeepers: Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brothers. Shallum [was] the chief;

18.w: and until then at the Gate of the King on the east they [had been] the gatekeepers for the camps of the sons of Levi.

19.w: And Shallum son of Kore, son of Ebiasaph, son of Korah, and his brothers from the house of his father, the Korahites, [were] in charge of the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tabernacle—and their fathers [were] over the camp of YHWH, keepers of the entrance.

20.w: And Phinehas son of Eleazar had been the officer over them formerly; YHWH [was] with him.

21.w: Zechariah son of Meshelemiah [was] keeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.

22.w: All those chosen for gatekeepers at the thresholds [were] two hundred and twelve. They in their villages were reckoned—David and Samuel the seer had appointed them to their trusted office.

23.w: And they and their children [were] over the gates of the house of YHWH, even of the house of the tabernacle, by watches.

24.w: On the four sides were the gatekeepers: The east, west, north, and south.

25.w: And their brothers in their villages were to come in for seven days from time to time with these.

26.w: For in office were four chief gatekeepers; they [were] Levites, and they were over the chambers and over the treasuries of the house of God.

27.w: And around the house of God they lodged, because on them [was] the watch. And they [were] over the opening morning by morning.

28.w: And [some] of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for by number they brought them in and by number they took them out.

29.w: And some of them were appointed over the vessels and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, and over the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.

30.w: And [some] of the sons of the priests were mixing the ointment of the spices.

31.w: And Mattithiah of the Levites (he [was] the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite) was entrusted over the work of the flat cakes.

32.w: And some of the sons of the Kohathites from their brothers [were] over the bread of the arrangement, to prepare [it] Sabbath by Sabbath.

33.w: And these singers, the heads of fathers of the Levites in the chambers, [were] free, for by day and by night [they were] over them in the work.

34.w: These the heads of the fathers of the Levites throughout their generations [were] heads; these dwelt in Jerusalem.

35.w: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, and the name of his wife [was] Maacah,

36.w: and His firstborn son [was] Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,

37.w: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.

38.w: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt alongside their brothers in Jerusalem with their brothers.

39.w: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.

40.w: And a son of Jonathan: Merib-baal, and Merib-baal begat Micah.

41.w: And the sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, [and Ahaz].

42.w: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;

43.w: and Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah [was] his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.

44.w: And unto Azel [were] six sons, and these their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. These [were] the sons of Azel.
